feat: Implement Widget Hot Reload for instant development feedback

- Added dynamic widget reloading to the dev site, allowing changes to be reflected instantly without rebuilding or deploying.
- Created a catch-all API endpoint at `/api/widgets/[...slug].ts` to serve widget HTML from the filesystem with security checks.
- Introduced `widgetHotReload.ts` utility for reload functions and keyboard shortcut setup.
- Developed `WidgetReloader.tsx` component for an optional UI to trigger reloads.
- Updated `WidgetEmbed.tsx` to handle environment detection and routing for dev and production modes.
- Modified existing pages (`concerts.tsx`, `journalism.tsx`) to include the new reload functionality.
- Comprehensive documentation added, including guides and implementation details.
- Ensured zero breaking changes to existing widget functionality and production behavior.
\n\nAuthor: mccal
